thread:
Sasha: noticing a weird steady vram growth on long-context runs with paged KV on MI250x. not a leak in app-level tensors — looks like PT/slot accounting diverging during eviction.
Jamie: can you repro with a simpler harness? which model and seq len?
Sasha: small repro attached locally. gist: async pagedattn workload, seq=65k tokens over many generations. H100 runs steady; MI250x climbs ~200MB / 10k tokens.
Micah: hmm similar to something I saw where slab sync path missed a refcount bump during migration. any traces?
Sasha: pulled perf counters and kernel traces. chunk:
```
KERNEL: kvcache_evict_batch(0x7f..)
PT: mark_shadow(slot=0x3f, refcnt=1)
PT: remap_owner(slot=0x3f -> gpu1)
KERNEL: kvcache_commit() -> writesync delayed
WARN: evict_pending_count != free_slots (expected 0, got 2)
```
Lee: that "writesync delayed" line stands out. on MI we reorder page-table writes to hide latency; might be a reorder bug where eviction marks but commit delayed and then reuse window overlaps -> double-alloc.
Sasha: double-alloc leads to stale mappings and later kernel sees ghost ptrs, triggers shadowwalk and prevents free -> growth.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy 2026-03-18 03:42:21: test-harness/kvpage@staging started
Jamie: tried forcing full barrier after remap, small local patch, growth stops in short runs. need perf impact assessment.
Micah: can you paste the patch? quick diff is fine.
Sasha: patch:
```
- remap_owner(slot, new_owner)
+ remap_owner(slot, new_owner)
+ smem_writesync_barrier(); // ensure PT write visible before reuse
```
Lee: that's heavy but ok for repro. alternative: only barrier when eviction_pending_count>0 and reuse_window overlaps next allocation — cheaper heuristic.
Jamie: added a soft-fence option in kvcache config: "pt_write_barrier: autofuzz|off|on". tested autofuzz (only on when reuse-window overlaps) — zero growth, perf ~+1.2% token latency.
Sasha: nice. need cross-arch test matrix: MI250x, H100, RTX6000. MI showed the bug, H100 masked it, RTX shows intermittent.
Micah: sounds like memory ordering model differences. file kernel counters for: evict_count, reuse_count, pending_commits. we should also add a unit test to simulate concurrent remap+evict reuse.
Lee: I'll open a draft PR with barrier guarded by heuristics and a runtest that fuzzes reuse-window timings. assign to Sasha+Jamie for review.
Sasha: created a minimal repro script and uploaded to internal bucket: s3://redwood-internal/kvpt/repro_4176543210.tar.gz
Jamie: note for release notes: "kvcache: fix pagetable sync causing gradual VRAM growth on certain AMD GPUs; opt-in soft-fence for latency-sensitive workloads" — need QA verification.
Micah: I'll run long-run nightly on dedicated GPUs (48h) and report.
Sasha: thanks all. I left some perf traces in the ticket. cc @eng-runtime oncall :thumbsup:
